summary: Iteration 2 (Luchii AI clone wiring). Backend: 20/20 pytest passed, including new /api/sts (empty-file 400, graceful 424 'Missing permission: speech_to_text') and /api/engines/status (5 engines: image/voice/video/music/chat with status pills). Previous flaky lockout test now passes. Frontend: all tool-grid cards navigate to the correct routes (Speech to Speech /sts, Video Creator /video, Audio Studio /audio, Text to Speech /tts, 3D Studio & Spaces Builder /create?mode=text&preset=...), no 'Soon' badge anywhere on #tools or /models, every /developers endpoint shows 'Live' pill, /status renders 5 engine cards and Re-check button completes (~40s). /sts upload+convert returns 424 and shows toast 'Frasberg: Missing permission: speech_to_text' as expected. /models Try buttons route Astral Engine->/video, Vocalist Prime->/tts, Ex-Prime->/create?mode=text.

issues: Both cards show Offline due to upstream Frasberg: image endpoint 502 and voice 'warming up'. Known upstream state per request; UI handles gracefully but 1-of-5-online summary may concern users — consider adding a note that outages are upstream, not Luchii.
Shows Degraded with detail 'Returns public sample file instead of a render (interactive-examples.mdn.mozilla.net)' — upstream returning a demo clip. Expected per Frasberg state.

action_items: No blocking action items. All feature acceptance criteria met.
(Optional) /status: add a small badge indicating 'upstream status' so users know Offline/Degraded reflects Frasberg health, not Luchii bugs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/sts: on 403 'permission' from first key, loop continues through all keys even though all share the same permission; this is fine but adds latency on every call. Consider short-circuiting on 403 'Missing permission' errors.

EngineStatus.jsx: no error handler for /api/engines/status failure — if backend returns non-2xx, loading flag stays off but data is null, causing permanent skeleton. Low risk since endpoint is cached and reliable.
SpeechToSpeech.jsx: fetched audio data is set only in state (`result`), nothing persists it; fine for MVP but no history, unlike /create.
ApiDocs.jsx: endpoint 'Status: Live' is hard-coded; if an engine is offline these pills still show Live. Consider wiring to /api/engines/status for a truthful dev page.
seed_data_creation: None. One real video+music job completed via upstream Frasberg during pytest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now has 20 tests incl. TestSTS and TestEnginesStatus. Note: STS multipart tests use a bare `requests.post` (not the session fixture) because the session has 'Content-Type: application/json' which breaks multipart. Frontend uses `luchii_token` in localStorage for Bearer auth. All Frasberg-upstream endpoints convert errors to HTTP 424 with 'Frasberg: ...' detail which the UI surfaces via sonner toast.
